description: This file defines the abstract class IOFactory, which provides a factory pattern for creating spreadsheet readers and writers, including methods to auto-detect file types, instantiate appropriate classes, and handle external dependencies for the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: IOFactory
classes.description: A factory class providing static methods to create spreadsheet readers and writers, identify file types, and load spreadsheets with automatic reader selection.

methods.name: createWriter
methods.description: Creates an instance of a writer class based on the specified type.

methods.name: createReader
methods.description: Creates an instance of a reader class based on the specified type.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a spreadsheet from a file, automatically detecting the file type.

methods.name: identify
methods.description: Returns the detected file type of a spreadsheet file.

methods.name: createReaderForFile
methods.description: Creates a reader instance suitable for a given file by inspecting its extension and content.

methods.name: getReaderTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Guesses the reader type from the file extension.

methods.name: registerWriter
methods.description: Registers a new writer class with a specific type name.

methods.name: registerReader
methods.description: Registers a new reader class with a specific type name.
